title: Companion native input actions
description: Proves native input replacement and back navigation through the assigned device.

open-filters.intent: Open the native workspace filter sheet.

wait-for-search.intent: Confirm the native filter input is ready.

fill-search.intent: Scope the visible project and machine choices to Farmslot entries.

replace-search.intent: Change the visible filter scope to Mini without retaining the prior query.

dismiss-keyboard.intent: Complete the filter query and reveal the controls hidden behind the native keyboard.

close-filters.intent: Return from filter editing to the review queue.

confirm-review.intent: Confirm Back returned to the review queue.

capture-proof.label: Review filters after native input replacement and Back
capture-proof.intent: Retain the final native state as review evidence.
